purpose: Corrected reproducibility comparison replacing the previous hardcoded report. All values are computed from existing artifact files, not hardcoded.

1shot.explanation: Known-class pairing differs: original used ['Red Dane cattle', 'Ayrshire cattle'], audit used ['Red Dane cattle', 'Jersey cattle']. This means the evaluator sampled a different known class as the second way in 2-way episodes, making per-episode accuracy sequences non-comparable even with the same seed. Accuracy DIFFERS beyond ±2pp tolerance: original 57.50% vs audit 66.50% (delta +9.00pp). Macro-F1: original 52.65% vs audit 55.81% (delta +3.16pp). Per-episode accuracy sequences differ, confirming non-identical episode sampling.

previous_report_issue: The previous comparison_diff_report.json contained a hardcoded explanation claiming 'Exact match on mean accuracy (57.50%)' which was factually incorrect: the audit rerun produced 66.50% 1-shot accuracy, not 57.50%.
